fusion_specification.selection_evidence: Task 3.5B grid sweep over alpha in {0.0, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0}

target_specification.clinical_definition: Growth faltering occurring within (0, 180] days following the index visit, defined as either: (1) Crossing a WHO growth faltering threshold (WAZ < -2.00 or WAZ < -3.00), or (2) An acute weight-for-age z-score drop of >= 0.50 standard deviations within 180 days.
target_specification.censoring_rule: Visits with zero follow-up encounters in (0, 180] days were defaulted to 0 (negative). Task 3.5C confirmed the hybrid's advantage is stable when these 46 visits are excluded.

date_of_birth_handling.encoder_behavior_on_unseen: The OneHotEncoder was fitted with handle_unknown='ignore'. When an infant with an unseen calendar birth date (any date outside 2018-2022) is evaluated at inference, all 293 one-hot columns evaluate to 0.0 without throwing a runtime error.
date_of_birth_handling.deployment_limitation: In future clinical deployments, newly born infants will yield all zeros across 84.7% of the model's transformed feature inputs (293 out of 346 columns). While the model continues to function using age_days and clinical measurements, these 293 columns represent historical cohort markers that cannot distinguish between future birth dates. This represents a significant architectural generalization risk.
date_of_birth_handling.freezing_policy: FROZEN AS VERIFIED. In accordance with Task 3.9A rules, no retuning or pipeline modification is performed.

sequence_pipeline_specification.static_features_status: Birth and demographic statics (sex, birth weight, delivery type, DOB) excluded from 3D tensor

point_in_time_safety.tabular_branch: Verified. Input features include current encounter measurements and strictly historical rolling summaries (e.g., waz_rolling_mean_3, weight_velocity_kg_per_30d). No future visits or target fields enter the input matrix.
point_in_time_safety.sequence_branch: Verified. Sequence tensor contains up to 20 historical encounters strictly occurring at or prior to the index encounter date (t <= index_visit_date). Visits are sorted chronologically; encounters strictly following the index date are never included in the tensor.

calibration_status.status: NOT ESTABLISHED AS CLINICALLY CALIBRATED PROBABILITIES
calibration_status.details: The hybrid score is a linear blend between unweighted XGBoost (calibrated near empirical prevalence ~0.037) and class-weighted Transformer (trained with ~22:1 positive weighting, shifting raw scores to mean ~0.24). The blended scores serve as a highly effective risk-ranking index for triage, but cannot be interpreted as true posterior event probabilities without post-hoc calibration (e.g., Platt scaling or isotonic regression).

threshold_status.rationale: No clinical alert threshold has been formally approved or locked for clinical deployment. The illustrative threshold 0.50, the balanced screening threshold 0.064055 (~70% recall), and the high-sensitivity screening threshold 0.047440 (~80% recall) were derived post-hoc on the validation dataset and serve strictly as exploratory operating benchmarks.
threshold_status.recommendation: Before held-out test evaluation, clinical stakeholders must decide whether to evaluate a fixed screening cutoff (e.g., tau = 0.064055) or evaluate threshold-free ranking metrics (PR-AUC, ROC-AUC).

unresolved_pre_test_requirements.action_required: Formally lock either tau = 0.064055 (balanced screening) or tau = 0.047440 (high-sensitivity), or commit to pure threshold-free evaluation.
Stakeholders must decide if raw risk scores are acceptable for clinical ranking or if a post-hoc calibration layer is required for risk communication.
Research team must accept that 293 date_of_birth columns will evaluate to zero for future infants in deployment.
Held-out test split must be evaluated strictly once using child-clustered bootstrap with zero parameter or threshold tuning.
